role: Observation-derived spore extension for the FSIM sporangia route.

notes.pressure_field: Numeric CK counts are distributed as interval rates over the completed collection intervals, standardized over the measured period, smoothed with a three-day centered mean, and centered at reference_level.
notes.zero_interval_rule: Numeric zero-spore intervals suppress weather-generated cohorts; missing observations do not suppress weather production, and observed background dose is retained.
